Our story

Built by a club parent, for club owners

Apps By Angela started with a simple problem — managing a gymnastics club was a nightmare of spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups and paper registers. So Angela built an app to fix it.

What started as one club's solution grew into a fully featured, white-labelled platform used by clubs of all kinds. Every single feature exists because a real club needed it.

Unlike the big corporate platforms that have been bought and sold by investors, Apps By Angela is independent, personal, and still run by the person who built it — someone who has actually sat in your chair.

The platform

Not just an app. A complete platform.

When you sign up, you get three fully integrated products working together seamlessly.

📱
Member Mobile App

Your club's own branded app, live on the App Store and Google Play under your club name.

  • Your logo and colour scheme throughout
  • Parents manage bookings and view newsletters
  • Receive push notifications instantly
  • View waiting lists, accept or decline spaces
  • Shop for club merchandise and kit
  • Multiple parents linked to each child
🖥
Web Admin Panel

A powerful management dashboard accessible from any browser.

  • Full member management and applications
  • View and process payments and refunds
  • Manage classes, registers and timetables
  • Handle waiting list and parent requests
  • Manage competitions and events
  • Process merchandise orders
👔
Coach App

A dedicated view for your coaching team — assign coaches to classes and give them exactly what they need.

  • Coaches assigned to specific classes
  • Take registers directly from their phone
  • Create and share skill cards
  • Mark skill achievements per student
  • View their own coaching calendar
⚙
Full App Configuration

You're in control. Choose exactly which features are active for your club.

  • Toggle any feature on or off
  • Customise your member label (Gymnast, Dancer, etc.)
  • Choose which payment methods to accept
  • Configure your waiting list system
  • Control what parents and coaches can see

Everything your club needs

Registers & Classes

Members & Families
  • Multiple parents per child, each with own account

Notifications
  • Push notifications — not just email

FAQ

Common questions

Yes — completely. Your app is fully white-labelled with your club name, logo and colour scheme. It's listed on the App Store and Google Play under your club's name. Members will never see the Apps By Angela branding.
Not at all. The platform works for any club or organisation — dance schools, martial arts, swimming clubs, football academies, cheer, community groups and more. You can customise the member label (Gymnast, Dancer, Cheerleader, etc.) to suit your club.
Yes. Apps By Angela fully supports multiple locations under a single account. You can send notifications to specific locations and manage separate class timetables across all sites.

No long-term contracts. All plans are monthly and you can cancel at any time.
